observation: A PowerShell worktree-existence probe placed a semicolon-delimited Git statement sequence inside a hashtable value expression. PowerShell rejected the command at parse time before any statement executed.
containment: No filesystem, Git, provider, runtime or product action occurred.
The corrected probe executes each statement separately, captures LASTEXITCODE and only then constructs the result object.
The target worktree and worker branch were confirmed absent before creation.
